text: I bet $100 you didn't know there are some countries that look completely different but are almost exactly the same size.
Let's start with number 5, Nepal and Bangladesh.
They are only 22 kilometers apart but one touches the sky with Mount Everest while the other touches the ocean with its rivers.
Number 4 is Guinea and the United Kingdom.
